notes: Teferi, Master of Time: 'You may activate loyalty abilities of Teferi on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant.' On seat 1's turn seat 0 activates [+1] (draw a card, then discard a card: the drawn top card is the only card in hand, so it is discarded). Loyalty 3 -> 4. CR 606.3 still allows one loyalty ability of the permanent per turn, so a second one ([-3]) is refused the same turn.
